checks: committed durable guard survives connection loss and rejects two concurrent cooperative writers
a second capture is refused while the first durable guard remains active
unknown commit remains fenced until nonce proves termination and durable receipt proves commit
rollback is reconciled only after termination and the second tenant is unchanged
guard admission cannot pass a writer already holding the serialization row
limits: Synthetic durable guard protocol in three isolated PostgreSQL databases; no product guard, F4, F5, RLS, matching, cursor, or production schema.
Writers cooperate explicitly; this does not prove complete writer coverage, real network partitions, security grants, deployment, or distributed deadlock freedom.
